class.name: OcgAISManipulator
class.brief_description: Interactive object class to manipulate local transformation of another interactive object or a group of objects via mouse. It manages three types of manipulations in 3D space: - translation through axis - scaling within axis - rotation around axis To enable one of this modes, selection mode (from 1 to 3) is to be activated. There are three orthogonal transformation axes defined by position property of the manipulator. Particular transformation mode can be disabled for each of the axes or all of them. Furthermore each of the axes can be hidden or made visible. The following steps demonstrate how to attach, configure and use manipulator for an interactive object: Step 1. Create manipulator object and adjust it appearance: Note that you can enable only one manipulation mode but have all visual parts displayed. This code allows you to view manipulator and select its manipulation parts. Note that manipulator activates mode on part selection. If this mode is activated, no selection will be performed for manipulator. It can be activated with highlighting. To enable this: Step 2. To perform transformation of object use next code in your event processing chain: Step 3. To deactivate current manipulation mode use: Step 4. To detach manipulator from object use: The last method erases manipulator object.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs a manipulator object with default placement and all parts to be displayed.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs a manipulator object with input location and positions of axes and all parts to be displayed.

method.name: SetPart_2
method.description: Disable or enable visual parts for translation, rotation or scaling for some axis. By default all parts are enabled (will be displayed).

method.name: SetPart_1
method.description: Disable or enable visual parts for translation, rotation or scaling for ALL axes. By default all parts are enabled (will be displayed).

method.name: EnableMode
method.description: Enable manipualtion mode.

method.name: SetModeActivationOnDetection
method.description: Enables mode activation on detection (highlighting). By default, mode is activated on selection of manipulator part.

method.name: IsModeActivationOnDetection
method.description: Returns true if manual mode activation is enabled.

method.name: StartTransform
method.description: Init start (reference) transformation.

method.name: Transform_1
method.description: Apply to the owning objects the input transformation.

method.name: RecomputeTransformation
method.description: Apply camera transformation to flat skin manipulator

method.name: RecomputeSelection
method.description: Recomputes sensitive primitives for the given selection mode.

method.name: StopTransform
method.description: Reset start (reference) transformation.

method.name: Transform_2
method.description: Apply transformation made from mouse moving from start position (save on the first Transform() call and reset on DeactivateCurrentMode() call.) to the in/out mouse position (theX, theY)

method.name: ObjectTransformation
method.description: Computes transformation of parent object according to the active mode and input motion vector. You can use this method to get object transformation according to current mode or use own algorithm to implement any other transformation for modes.

method.name: DeactivateCurrentMode
method.description: Make inactive the current selected manipulator part and reset current axis index and current mode. After its call HasActiveMode() returns false.

method.name: Detach
method.description: Detaches himself from the owner object, and removes itself from context.

method.name: Object_1
method.description: Returns the first (leading) object of the owning objects.

method.name: Object_2
method.description: Returns one of the owning objects. raises program error if theIndex is more than owning objects count or less than 1.

method.name: IsAttached
method.description: Returns true if manipulator is attached to some interactive object (has owning object).

method.name: HasActiveMode
method.description: Returns true if some part of manipulator is selected (transformation mode is active, and owning object can be transformed).

method.name: SetZoomPersistence
method.description: Enable or disable zoom persistence mode for the manipulator. With this mode turned on the presentation will keep fixed screen size.

method.name: ZoomPersistence
method.description: Returns state of zoom persistence mode, whether it turned on or off.

method.name: SetTransformPersistence
method.description: Redefines transform persistence management to setup transformation for sub-presentation of axes.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns poition of manipulator interactive object.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Sets position of the manipulator object.

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Sets size (length of side of the manipulator cubic bounding box.

method.name: SetGap
method.description: Sets gaps between translator, scaler and rotator sub-presentations.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Fills presentation.

method.name: ComputeSelection
method.description: Computes selection sensitive zones (triangulation) for manipulator.

method.name: IsAutoHilight
method.description: Disables auto highlighting to use HilightSelected() and HilightOwnerWithColor() overridden methods.

method.name: ClearSelected
method.description: Method which clear all selected owners belonging to this selectable object ( for fast presentation draw ).

method.name: HilightOwnerWithColor
method.description: Method which hilight an owner belonging to this selectable object ( for fast presentation draw ).
